content.text:
**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 12.4**

§ 12.4 imposes on Meridian a non-compete covering development, marketing, sale, or acquisition of "any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory," running for the term plus 24 months. This binds our party, has undefined scope, and exceeds the walk-away threshold. It also flatly contradicts § 12.3, where Copperleaf acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.

Redline (validated, preferred level): delete § 12.4 in full, with the narrowed fallback (single named competing product, term only, 12-month cap, carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions) offered in the comment.
